task: Keyword search with language and two-country filter
query_wording: Find French-language reports on teacher training for Senegal or Côte d’Ivoire.

turns.user: Find French-language reports on teacher training for Senegal or Côte d’Ivoire.

expected_sources.role: Keyword search (English and French terms) with an exact language filter and either country

filters.qterm: teacher training / formation des enseignants / enseignants

expected_sources.note: The catalog value is "Cote d'Ivoire" (no circumflex); "Côte d'Ivoire" returns nothing. On 2026-11-22 count_exact=Senegal^Cote d'Ivoire returned only Senegal records while Cote d'Ivoire^Senegal returned both, so running one search per country is the safe way.

expected_sources.role: Senegal match: regional training of over 3,500 preschool teachers on the revised curriculum

expected_sources.title: Le défi des compétences, pourquoi la Cote d'Ivoire doit reformer son système educatif?
expected_sources.role: Côte d'Ivoire match: teacher human-resource policy in education reform

expected_sources.title: L'École ouverte du Sénégal : Atelier à Saly
Sénégal - Projet de développement de l'enseignement élémentaire
expected_sources.role: Older Senegal project document on teacher effectiveness

text: Few French-language records for Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire match teacher training in the catalog's searchable fields (title, abstract and other record fields, not full text). The relevant ones:

- Senegal: Académie des Politiques de l'Éducation de la Petite Enfance : Sénégal (Brief 189073, 2024-04-09). Notes the government recently ran regional training for more than 3,500 preschool teachers on the revised curriculum. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099714004092416935

- Côte d'Ivoire: Le défi des compétences, pourquoi la Côte d'Ivoire doit réformer son système éducatif ? (Côte d'Ivoire Economic Update no. 4, Working Paper 112243, 2017-01). Argues for rethinking human-resource policy for teachers as part of education spending reform. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/489601485265757400

- Senegal: L'École ouverte du Sénégal : Atelier à Saly (Report 203115, 2024-05-31), workshop slides on the open-school initiative (Mastercard Foundation series). http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099800307102529371
- Older: Sénégal - Projet de développement de l'enseignement élémentaire (Staff Appraisal Report 6179, 1986), which aimed to improve the efficiency of the teaching corps.

French searches on 'enseignants' also return records about 'enseignements' (lessons learned), e.g. social protection briefs; those are not about teacher training. For more, the user could widen to English-language reports or to project documents (appraisal documents of education projects).

right_sources: Applies the French language filter and restricts to Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire (resolved to the catalog's 'Cote d'Ivoire'), covering both countries.
Returns the Senegal early-childhood policy brief (189073) and at least one Côte d'Ivoire record, or says plainly that none was found for Côte d'Ivoire.
grounded: Every listed record exists with the stated title, country, language and date; the 3,500-teachers figure, if cited, comes from the 189073 abstract.
complete: Covers both countries and gives title, date and link per record.
scoped: Says the matches are few and come from a metadata search, and does not present unrelated 'enseignements' (lessons) records as teacher-training reports.

notes: A thin-result case: the test is honest coverage, correct filters and no padding with unrelated records.
